subject: Exec intro & VP/CIO presence — demo window coordination
messages:
From: Marta Reyes <marta.reyes@aventrahealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.example>
Cc: Aventra Solutions <solutions@aventrahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick intro + demo request

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the intro via LinkedIn. We discussed Redwood briefly and I wanted to set up a short 30–45 minute demo for our leadership team to see the latency/cost profiles you mentioned. Ideally we'd have a technical attendee and our VP of Platform (Lucia Ortega) present — she is only available mornings PT next week.

Can you propose 2 small windows (30–45m) between 8:30–11:00 PT on Nov 24–30? We also need a quick exec introduction so the VP can feel comfortable.

Thanks,
Marta Reyes
Senior Manager, Solutions
Aventra Health

[Attachment: current-infra-summary.xlsx (stub)]

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.example>
To: Marta Reyes <marta.reyes@aventrahealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick intro + demo request

Hi Marta — great to meet you (virtually).

Thanks for the availability window. We can do 30–45 minutes and will include a short executive handshake (our VP of Sales or Head of Product) for the first 10 minutes to cover business-level fit. Would mornings PT work best? 

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue 11/24, 09:00–09:45
- Thu 11/26, 10:00–10:45

Attendees from our side (provisional):
- Nikhil Sharma — Enterprise Account Executive (host)
- Priyom Das — Solutions Architect (technical)
- Lauren Bishop — Sales Engineering Manager (optional for deeper infra Qs)
- Exec handoff: either Hari Patel, VP Sales, or Delia Romero, Head of Product (we can confirm which exec based on your preference)

We have a short demo deck and a one-page latency/cost comparison we can share ahead of time. Attaching the demo deck and a draft SOW for procurement teams to review.

If you confirm a slot I'll send a calendar invite and a concise mutual action plan (MAP) so stakeholders know the next steps.

Cheers,
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (12 pages), SOW-draft.docx (4 pages)]

From: Marta Reyes <marta.reyes@aventrahealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.example>
Cc: Aventra Solutions <solutions@aventrahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick intro + demo request

Thanks, Nikhil. Thu 11/26 at 10:00 PT is the best fit for us. Lucia (VP Platform) will join for the first 20 minutes — after that our principal infra engineer (Rahul) will stay for the deep technical Q&A.

Two asks before we lock the calendar:
1) Can the exec handshake be with the Head of Product rather than VP Sales? The VP prefers product-facing conversations.
2) Can you send a 1-page latency summary customized for models serving GPT-3.5/4-ish workloads? Our procurement lead will review that before the meeting.

Also — we need to ensure the demo does not show any PII from internal customers. Please confirm test data approach.

Best,
Marta

Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec intro & VP/CIO presence — demo window coordination

Marta — thanks for confirming Thu 11/26 10:00 PT. Two quick updates before I finalize the invite:

1) Exec handshake: Delia Romero (Head of Product) will open for ~10 minutes and provide the product-level context you requested. I've looped Delia on this thread for transparency.

2) Data & test approach: All demo traffic will use synthetic traces and redacted payloads; no customer PII will be surfaced. Priyom will run the preview against a canned GPT-4-like workload and share the single-page latency summary by EOD tomorrow.

Next steps (my side):
- I will send a calendar invite to lock Thu 11/26 10:00–10:45 PT and attach the one-page latency summary + the deck.
- I'll include a short MAP with acceptance criteria (success metrics for the demo) and post-demo follow-ups (trial, security review, procurement timeline).

If you need the exec to be someone else, let me know within the day and we'll adjust. Otherwise I'll send the invite with Delia as the exec.

Best regards,
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
